description: This Java class `PoliciesJournalTestHelper` provides test utilities for interacting with an Akka persistence in-memory journal for policies. It enables retrieval of all events for a specific domain ID, converting journal entries into domain objects, primarily used for testing purposes within the policies services.

classes.name: PoliciesJournalTestHelper
classes.description: A helper class for testing with Akka persistence journal, parameterized with a domain object type J.

methods.name: PoliciesJournalTestHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with an ActorSystem, journal entry mapper, and domain ID mapper.

methods.name: getAllEvents
methods.description: Retrieves all journal events associated with a specific domain ID, returning a list of domain objects.

methods.name: getAllEventEnvelopes
methods.description: Fetches all event envelopes from the in-memory journal for a given persistence ID.

methods.name: convertEventEnvelopeToDomainObject
methods.description: Converts an EventEnvelope into a domain object J using the provided mapping function.

methods.name: runBlockingWithReturn
methods.description: Runs a reactive stream source synchronously, returning a list of items or throwing an exception on failure.
